WITH june_data AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date
    FROM cities 
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06-%'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as rn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY) as rn_prev
    FROM june_data
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        rn - rn_prev + 1 as streak_group
    FROM ranked
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        streak_group,
        COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_group
),
max_streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        MAX(streak_length) as max_consecutive_days
    FROM streak_lengths
    GROUP BY country_code_2
)
SELECT * FROM max_streaks ORDER BY max_consecutive_days DESC, country_code_2

        SELECT 
            country_code_2,
            insert_date,
            prev_date,

        FROM with_gap

    streak_lengths AS (

            streak_id,
            COUNT(*) as streak_length
        FROM streak_groups

    SELECT country_code_2, insert_date, COUNT(*) as city_count
    FROM cities

    GROUP BY country_code_2, insert_date

with_prev_date AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        city_count,
        LAG(insert_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as prev_date,
        DATEDIFF('day', LAG(insert_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date), insert_date) as days_diff
    FROM daily_counts
),
with_streak_id AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        insert_date,
        city_count,
        CASE 
            WHEN days_diff IS NULL OR days_diff > 1 THEN 1
            ELSE streak_id
        END AS streak_start,
        CASE 
            WHEN days_diff IS NULL OR days_diff > 1 THEN days_diff
            ELSE 1
        END AS streak_continues
    FROM with_prev_date
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT 
        country_code_2,
        streak_start,
        SUM(streak_continues) as streak_length
    FROM with_streak_id
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_start
),
max_streaks AS (

        MAX(streak_length) as max_streak
    FROM streak_lengths

),
ranked AS (

        max_streak,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY max_streak DESC) as streak_rank

)
